MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-AN_EMPTY_CHEST.title: An Empty Chest
MULTIPLAYEREXPANDED-AN_EMPTY_CHEST.pages: An empty chest waits for the party. Each living player must offer one unenchanted Common, Uncommon or Rare card, then choose from the shared chest.
There are no living allies to share the chest.
Each living player offers one eligible card to the shared chest.
Choose an unenchanted Common, Uncommon or Rare card to offer.
Choose a card from the shared chest.
